experiments.purpose: Compare an oldest-only drive pulse with its matched newest-only pulse at the same current drive and waiting time.
Matched temporal-position contrast for the oldest-only pulse.
Measure how the oldest-pulse effect changes with waiting time.
Matched temporal-position contrast at the longer waiting time.

expression: q = sum(history * exp(times / p[4])); m = q * exp(-h / p[4]); o = p[0] + p[1]*u + p[2]*h + p[3]*m
prospective_contrast: At fixed u, h, and pulse magnitude, compare histories [1,0,0,0] and [0,0,0,1]. The model predicts a larger effect for the more recent pulse; increasing h attenuates both effects by the same exponential waiting-time factor.

quantities.interpretation: Exponentially weighted integral proxy for the prior drive record; because times are negative, more recent intervals receive greater weight.
quantities.name: q

quantities.interpretation: Weighted prior-drive contribution attenuated during the current waiting interval.
quantities.name: m

refutation_condition: Reject this response structure if matched pulse-position contrasts are absent, reverse direction, or fail to attenuate with h beyond the 0.015 response error bound; also reject if it misses the required dev or later independent RMSE threshold.
scientific_change: Replace the assumption that response depends only on current drive and waiting time with a history-dependent model: prior drives contribute through an exponentially weighted record, whose effect decays during the wait. The shared time constant is a parsimonious testable constraint, not an established mechanism.
